transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?
I don’t care about the projects and hobbies I used to love anymore; nothing feels interesting to me now. It just feels like I've lost the spark for everything I used to enjoy.
How long has this lack of interest in your usual activities been going on? Has it been present most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?

It's been going on for a little over a year now, ever since I lost a big solar contract and the money got really tight. It is definitely there pretty much every single day, most of the day. Even on my days off, I just sit on the couch or in my truck feeling absolutely no spark to do anything.
Have you had any periods of normal mood or full interest in activities lasting several weeks or more during this past year, or has this low mood been continuous?

No, I haven't had any breaks or normal periods at all; it has been completely continuous. Ever since I lost that solar contract and the money got tight, it's just been this constant, heavy feeling every single day. I haven't had even a week of feeling back to normal.
Have you noticed any days or moments, even brief ones, when your mood lifted noticeably, or has it been consistently low without any improvement?

No, it's been consistently low without any real improvement. I wake up every single day with this heavy, sinking feeling in my chest that just hangs over me from my first cup of coffee until I crawl back into bed. Even on my days off, there is absolutely no spark or lift in my mood.
